items.name: Mississippi
items.fact: Principal river of the central United States.
facts: Principal river of the central United States.
Runs from Minnesota to the Gulf of Mexico.
With the Missouri, among the world’s longest systems.

items.name: Mackenzie
facts: Canada’s longest river system.
Flows to the Arctic Ocean.

items.name: Saint Lawrence
items.fact: Drains the Great Lakes to the Atlantic.
facts: Drains the Great Lakes to the Atlantic.
Forms part of the U.S.–Canada border.

items.name: Rio Grande
facts: Part of the U.S.–Mexico border.
Called the Río Bravo in Mexico.
Runs from Colorado to the Gulf of Mexico.

items.name: Colorado River
facts: Carved the Grand Canyon.
Lower reaches form part of the U.S.–Mexico border.

items.name: Yukon
items.fact: Major river of Alaska and Yukon.
facts: Major river of Alaska and Yukon.
Flows to the Bering Sea.

items.name: Missouri
items.fact: Longest river in the United States.
facts: Longest river in the United States.
The Mississippi’s longest tributary.

items.name: Columbia
items.fact: Great river of the Pacific Northwest.
facts: Great river of the Pacific Northwest.
Rises in British Columbia.

items.name: Ohio River
items.fact: Major eastern tributary of the Mississippi.
facts: Major eastern tributary of the Mississippi.
Forms much of the Midwest–South state line.
